The tutorials run a whole mapping workflow on published Papua New Guinea
data shipped with tidydiversity. Each tab gives a short preview; follow the
link for the full analysis.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidymapr)
library(tidydiversity)
```

## Papua New Guinea {.tabset}

### Mt Wilhelm ants

Ground ants at baits along the Mt Wilhelm elevational gradient
(`png_ants`; Moses et al. 2023): site map, richness on a map and distance
decay. [Full tutorial](case-png-wilhelm.html).

```{r wilhelm, fig.alt = "Study sites along Mt Wilhelm coloured by elevation band"}
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm")
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```
